verdict_short: FIRST SUB-9 LAPS: 8.96 / 8.93 after a lap-1 contact at s 26.8 (right wall, 0.19 m tracking error); stopped early
verdict: Pace confirmed: 8.96 and 8.93 on paper 8.728 (gap ~0.22). The contact came on lap 1 just after the warmup cap lifted, at s 26.8 with localization exact and only 0.19 m of lateral error: b0.05 sits ~0.10 m closer to the right wall than b0.15 on the straight-ish sections s 26-27, 33, 38-39, where its right-side slack is 0.01-0.11 m over the measured p99 wander. Timed-lap wander on M06 itself: s25-28 -0.17, s37-40 -0.16, s33 -0.06. Next: b0.15 geometry blended into s25-28 and s37.3-40 (raceline/blend_lines.py), paper 8.810.
